sequence.def: An ordered list of numbers, called terms, written a_0, a_1, a_2, ... or starting at a_1. It is a function whose inputs are whole numbers (the positions), so its graph is a set of separate dots.

arithmetic-sequence.def: A sequence with a common difference d: each term is the previous term plus d, so a_n = a_0 + dn, or a_n = a_k + d(n - k) from any known term a_k. Its terms change by equal amounts.

geometric-sequence.def: A sequence with a common ratio r: each term is the previous term times r, so g_n = g_0 r^n, or g_n = g_k r^(n - k) from any known term g_k. Its terms change by amounts that are themselves multiplied by r.
